notes.title: Major Update 2.00a
notes.notes:
After almost 3 years from one of the most important projects of our studio, we’re happy to announce Agent Lovesdick has received a major update. 

Since you guys really enjoyed the stealth mechanics, we’ve removed the JRPG battles and improved the game mechanics you all enjoyed. Check out a video showing moments of the new gameplay.

https://youtu.be/tkUIFpCmxec

As you can see in the video, now you can hide in shadows, dash and you can actually shoot at your enemies! Also, the boss fighting is completely remade and now it’s much more fun and challenging!

The NSFW scenes are the same as in the old version.

We hope you all enjoy this major update and if you already have the game, you only need to download it. It’s a free update! If you don’t have it, its price increased a little bit, but you can get it with 30% OFF during our May Week-Long Sale 2022!

Thank you all for supporting us and don’t forget to follow our Steam page to receive the latest news.

Male Doll Team

Hello everyone!

I would like to say thank you for your support, and in the past days, some players have reported me a few bugs. I already fixed them, and it will be automatically downloaded. You can check the list below:


 When you were on Mr. Trumpson's Tournament, on the stairway (specifically), you could walk through the mountain because the floor was bugged;
 One of the orcs on West Poll path was bugged - it didn’t disappear after you killed it;
 The background of Gleen's Box's Monster had an error;
 One slime in Rebel Nymes' Mansion couldn't move, it only turned to the left and to the right;
 If you finished the game during the night, you were teleported to the last cutscene and the game turns to day time, but the sky was still dark;


The first unstable build of our new game will be launched on Itch.Io in a few weeks, and you can follow us from there.  Also, if you haven't bought the game yet, enjoy our special discount!

notes.title: Wanna do a fan German Version of Male Doll's Games?
notes.notes:
Hi, guys!

I'm here to say that I'm very happy due to a lot of German access. However, as many people around the world aren't fluent in English reading, I'm here to invite those who have German writing skills to make a fan version of Yuki's Tale and/or Agent Lovesdick (I'm building the demo of this last one, but if you want to help me it will be awesome). What can you get by helping me? One year of free copies of Male Doll's games (5 each month you choose the ones you want - 60 in one year), and a huuuuuuge thank you of a solo developer. As you know, I'm a drag queen game developer from Brazil, a third world country, and here it is really hard to survive with our own games because we have a looooot of taxes. If you enjoy my games, I'll be very thankful with your help.

Wanna help? Reply this post or send an email to maledollstudio@gmail.com

Thank you, guys
Victoria
